## What

`work_items:complete` uses its existing finish saga for both payload-stamped execution items and unstamped items linked by `sourcePlanSlug` and `sourcePlanItemIds`. A valid `payload.plan_item` stamp takes precedence: it identifies the execution instance and its harness, even when the source fields identify a template. Without a stamp, each complete source item identity is reflected in the source plan and the work-item harness.

## Why it matters

EI-28891215099029113 reproduced a split contract: conformance checked source fields while finish reflection and activation previews required a payload stamp. A canonical work-item could become terminal while its source plan line remained open and successors stayed blocked. The repair extends the existing finish saga rather than adding a reconciliation service. Successful closes now check each linked item's discovery/activation precondition before persisting terminal state, in both preview and real completion.

## How to apply

Read `work_items:get` for the work-item and `plans:items` for its exact source items. Inspect the source linkage and any payload stamp before choosing the target plan. Respect current claims, migration holds and external blockers; a reflection mismatch does not authorize clearing them.

Use `work_items:complete` with `validateOnly:true` to inspect the current preconditions. A stale discovery or activation refusal names the exact plan item; repair that prerequisite through the normal plan tools. Do not manually mark a line done to bypass the refusal.

The finish receipt includes `planItems`, one entry per linked target with its exact plan/harness/item identity, committed status, reflection diagnostic and claim-release result. The scalar `planItem` summarizes those entries (`mixed` when non-failing statuses differ); a failed entry keeps the aggregate finish incomplete. Source identities are not sliced or capped. Malformed source identities are rejected intact.

When a finish is incomplete, preserve its diagnostic and follow `finishFailureRecoveryAdvice`. Coordinate claim conflicts before retrying. Other retry-safe finish failures resume by replaying the same completion after the prerequisite is repaired. A legitimate coverage-guard skip preserves the actual nonterminal plan status when other work still covers it.

## Verification

On 2026-11-15, the old implementation failed six new regression cases while the stamped-instance control passed. After the repair, all 580 tests passed across `complete.test.ts`, `complete.finish-plan-stamp-coverage-guard.test.ts` and `complete.conformance-plan-link.test.ts` using the maintained Vitest runner. Cases cover one, two and three source items, reordered identities, a refusal on the last target, run-instance precedence, and stale discovery in preview and actual completion. This is focused implementation evidence; it is not a final-release or portfolio-plan completion verdict.
